verdict.rationale: Skyfire exposes a substantial live API surface: token creation (also possible via the Playground), charge, introspect, wallet balance, setting agent source IPs, and org-admin seller-agent creation, plus an MCP server for discovering sellers and minting tokens. However, several core flows are documented only as dashboard actions, including creating and managing API keys, clicking 'Create Service' and submitting it for approval, and browsing the Directory. Missing for 10: documented API equivalents for API-key management, service creation/approval and KYA verification; an explicit API/UI parity statement; a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404); independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
